summary: Oak Woods Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting termination of its August 2023 merger agreement with Huajin (China) Holdings. A March 2026 settlement agreement permitted termination without fees or penalties, effective April 16, 2026. OAKU also revoked its S-4 registration statement and proxy materials. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. As a SPAC termination, the registrant will likely liquidate or seek a new target; watch for shareholder redemptions and trust distribution timelines.
